scenario_title: DB pool cut on a downsized RDS
title: Latency and timeouts on billing-svc

detection.alert: billing-svc: p99 latency > 2 s for 5 min

impact: Requests slowed down and a share of them timed out on billing-svc
symptom: [ANOMALY] billing-svc 2026-06-30 09:34-13:44: billing-svc: 268 of 369 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-06-30 09:34 and 2026-06-30 13:44 UTC (peak error ratio 0.88 vs baseline median 0.0). 2 error templates, 1 first seen in this span.
error_templates: connection pool exhausted: timed out after 30000 ms waiting for a connection
c.f.b.api.UsageController - account <*> requested usage for a closed period

_templates.macro: Config change shrank the {svc} database connection pool; requests queued for connections and timed out (the billing-db downsize days earlier left no headroom).
_templates.remediation: Revert {key} to {old} in {file}; right-size aws_db_instance.billing_db before lowering pools again.

culprit.diff:
@@ -28,3 +28,3 @@ db.pool.max_size
 db:
-  pool_max_size: 80
+  pool_max_size: 8
   # managed by the platform team

rca.macro: Config change shrank the billing-svc database connection pool; requests queued for connections and timed out (the billing-db downsize days earlier left no headroom).
rca.remediation: Revert db.pool.max_size to 80 in config/billing-svc.yaml; right-size aws_db_instance.billing_db before lowering pools again.

action_items: Add validation bounds and a canary for risky config keys (pool / timeout / retry / flags).
Alert on the error signature `connection pool exhausted: timed out after 30000 ms waiting for a connection`.
